scope: 350 unique karaoke songIds from karaoke-data.js; timing eligibility checked against public/audio-manifest.json and the runtime player duration gate.

sourcePolicy.zingLrc: Fetched at runtime only; no DB or persistent lyrics cache. Existing in-memory cache has six-hour TTL.

lrclib.details: Sequential searches for 45 songs without Zing mappings; prior runtime audit covers songs with audio. Raw lyric/LRC bodies were not written to scan or completion reports.

sourcePolicy.forcedAlignment: Not run: imports are rejected_source or not_in_manifest; no authorized vocal/guide-vocal input was verified.

verificationRules: songId is the only catalog join key; display title never creates a mapping.
Candidate must have at least two valid LRC timestamp lines.
Candidate lyric text must match known static lyrics at >= 0.90 similarity.
Source duration must match current audio manifest within max(1.5 sec, 0.5%); the player repeats songId and actual-audio-duration checks at playback.
No timestamps were inferred or estimated; no audio was downloaded.
